title: 第8章  踏入初境
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
根据功法记载，资质上佳者只需月余即可练成第一层。
而陆渊只用了一盏茶的功夫。
这悟性，是真的逆天！
他只是引灵入体，灵力便在功法的牵引之下运行了一个周天。
没有用力，没有硬撑，甚至没有努力。
就像是开了智驾。
感受着薄雾般的灵力在体内奔涌，虽然数量多了，质量却参差不齐。
如功法所述：灵力不纯，如刀不锋。
得淬炼。
陆渊收敛心神，尝试着淬炼灵力。
然而灵力根本不受控制，就像是一团雾气，攥得越紧，散的越快。
他念头一动，运转开天之力。
一瞬间，体内灵力猛地一震，像是被一只无形大手狠狠攥住。
压缩、捶打、淬炼......
稀疏的灵力被揉在一起，粗壮的灵力变得更加致密。
一缕灵力淬炼之后，只剩十分之一大小，却比之前精纯了十倍。
一炷香后，经脉中的灵力由薄雾化作雨滴。
第二层，灵力如雨！
陆渊没有停。
灵力在经脉中继续运行，一遍遍地被开天之力淬炼。

每一缕新的灵力进入经脉，都要被那无形大手狠狠蹂躏一遍，除掉渣滓，留下精华。
雨滴越来越多，越来越密，开始融合，碰撞。
最终汇聚为一颗颗晶莹剔透的露珠在经脉中流淌。
第三层，灵力如露。
陆渊吐出一口浊气，嘴角不禁微微翘起。
一个时辰，他就走完了资质上佳者一年才能走完的路。
以开天之力修炼万化无极功，果然有搞头。
收敛心神，继续淬炼。
两个时辰后，露珠纷纷破碎，汇聚为溪流。
第四层，灵力如液。
四个时辰后，灵力更为浓稠，化作糊状。
第五层，灵力如浆。
六个时辰后，灵力被淬炼得如同胶质。
第六层，灵力如汞。
八个时辰后，灵力变得更加沉重，滞涩。
第七层，灵力如铅。
十个时辰后，灵力介于固液之间，温润内敛。
第八层，灵力如玉。
十二个时辰后，灵力重组排列，凝结为晶莹剔透的灵晶。
第九层，灵力如晶。

十二个时辰，万化无极功修至圆满。
一天走完别人一辈子都走不完的路，这简直匪夷所思。
不过仔细一想，也在情理之中。
那些晦涩难懂的段落，难以逾越的瓶颈，换做别人可能要卡上一年半载。
但以陆渊现在的悟性，一眼就能看出最优路径，修炼起来完全就是一马平川。
再加上开天之力无坚不摧的特性，原本淬炼灵力是水磨功夫，现在直接一气呵成。
词条效果两相叠加，修炼起来就是左脚踩右脚，原地起飞。
所以才仅用一天就将万化无极功修至圆满。
陆渊睁开双眼，两道灵光从他瞳孔深处激射而出，照得四壁生辉。
一股雄浑的气息从他体内涌出，像是沉睡的千年的火山骤然喷发。
气息如同凛冽罡风，向着四面八方席卷而去。
屋内桌椅板凳炸裂，碎木纷飞。
墙壁上裂纹密布，像是被无形巨力狠狠碾过。
陆渊收敛气息，经脉之内的璀璨灵晶熠熠生辉，宛若星海。
踏入初境了！
一枚蜕凡丹，万丈高楼平地起。
从今日起，他也是一名初境武者了。
站起身来活动筋骨，浑身上下传来一阵炒豆子般的脆响。
灵晶闪烁之间，体内雄浑灵力汹涌激荡，周身气息如排山倒海般倾泻而出，比一些老牌初境还要强横数十倍。
“万化无极功修至圆满，果然非同一般。”

陆渊心情大好，打水洗漱。
眼下踏入初境，也是时候接取任务了。
......
青州镇魔司，医房。
空气中的药材气息混杂着若有若无的血腥气。
林辰昨天被陆渊打伤，至今昏迷不醒。
好在他被镇魔司录取时，林嫚儿以家属身份同行，否则身边连个照顾的人都没有。
此刻林嫚儿双眼红肿，满面愁苦地看向站在床边的人影。
“周大人，我弟弟资质上佳，习武五年，好不容易进了镇魔司，却被陆渊打得重伤昏迷，求你为我们姐弟做主啊！”
林嫚儿扑通一声跪了下来，哭得浑身颤抖。
她在青州镇魔司举目无亲，周通，是唯一认识并且可以帮到她的人。
“起来说话。”
周通伸手将女人扶起，眉头随之皱了起来。
云安县的选拔结束之后，他一直在外出任务，没成想刚一回到镇魔司就得知林辰重伤的消息。
林辰是他看好的新人，入门考核之前已经是凡境六层，竟然接连两次都栽在了陆渊手中。
这怎么可能？
沉默片刻，周通问道：“到底是怎么回事？你如实道来。”
林嫚儿说得不清不楚，考核当日她并不在场，根本不清楚实情。
只是医师治疗时林辰清醒了一小会儿，她才得知伤人者是陆渊。
周通皱着眉继续问道：“昨日入门考核，林辰被评为几等？”

“乙等！”林嫚儿眼底顿时露出喜色，“昨日有书吏来过，要林辰伤势好了之后前往司务堂记名入册。”
“周大人，那陆渊一定是嫉恨我弟弟，才趁着考核之后林辰状态不足将他打成重伤，他这是想毁了我弟弟啊！”
周通点了点头，他也是这样猜测。
否则区区一个凡境二层，又怎能将林辰打成重伤。
陆渊此子，还真是心思歹毒。
一念及此，周通眼底顿时闪过一抹寒光。
他本就对陆渊看不上眼，没想到陆渊居然趁人之危，将已经通过考核的镇魔卫打成重伤。
难道司律堂就不管管吗？
好，你司律堂不管，我周通管！
他拿出二两银子放在床边，沉声说道：
“你放心，我是初境武者，更是在册七年的镇魔卫，对新人有赏功罚过之权。”
“这件事，陆渊必须受到严惩！”
“多谢周大人为我弟弟做主！”林嫚儿感激涕零。
周通点头，像是下定了某种决心，大步走出医房。
content_en:
According to the records of the technique, those with good qualifications can reach the first level in just over a month.
But Lu Yuan only used a cup of tea.
This understanding is truly heaven-defying!
He just introduced the spirit into his body, and the spiritual power circulated for a week under the pull of the technique.
No effort, no push, no effort.
It's like driving a smart car.
Feeling the mist-like spiritual power rushing through the body, although the quantity is large, the quality is uneven.
As stated in the technique: Impure spiritual power is like a knife without a sharp edge.
It has to be tempered.
Lu Yuan calmed down and tried to temper his spiritual power.
However, the spiritual power is out of control at all. It is like a mist. The tighter you hold it, the faster it disperses.
With a thought, he activated the power of opening the sky.
In an instant, the spiritual energy in his body shook violently, as if it was being grasped by an invisible hand.
Compress, beat, temper...
The sparse spiritual energy was kneaded together, and the thick spiritual energy became denser.
After the ray of spiritual power was tempered, it was only one-tenth the size, but it was ten times purer than before.
After one stick of incense, the spiritual energy in the meridians turned from mist into raindrops.
The second level, spiritual power is like rain!
Lu Yuan didn't stop.
The spiritual power continues to circulate in the meridians, being tempered by the power of opening the sky over and over again.
Every new ray of spiritual power that enters the meridians will be severely ravaged by the invisible hands, removing the dregs and leaving the essence.
There are more and more raindrops, getting denser and denser, starting to merge and collide.
Eventually it gathers into crystal clear dewdrops flowing in the meridians.
On the third level, spiritual power is like dew.
Lu Yuan exhaled a breath of turbid air, and the corners of his mouth could not help but curl up slightly.
In an hour, he completed the journey that would take a person with the best qualifications a year to complete.
Using the power of opening the sky to practice the Wuji Kung Fu of Ten Thousand Transformations, it really paid off.
Concentrate your mind and continue to temper.
Two hours later, the dewdrops broke and gathered into streams.
On the fourth level, spiritual power is like liquid.
Four hours later, the spiritual power became thicker and turned into a paste.
The fifth level, spiritual power is like pulp.
Six hours later, the spiritual power was tempered until it was like gelatin.
The sixth level, spiritual power is like mercury.
Eight hours later, the spiritual power became heavier and stagnant.
On the seventh level, spiritual power is like lead.
Ten hours later, the spiritual power was between solid and liquid, warm and restrained.
The eighth level, spiritual power is like jade.
Twelve hours later, the spiritual power was reorganized and arranged, condensing into crystal clear spiritual crystals.
On the ninth level, spiritual power is like crystal.
In twelve hours, the Wuji Gong of Ten Thousand Transformations will be cultivated to perfection.
It is simply unbelievable to complete a journey in one day that others would never complete in a lifetime.
But if you think about it carefully, it makes sense.
Those obscure passages and insurmountable bottlenecks would have taken someone else stuck for a year and a half.
But with Lu Yuan's current understanding, he could see the optimal path at a glance, and his cultivation was completely smooth sailing.
Coupled with the indestructible nature of the power of opening the sky, tempering spiritual power was originally a matter of water grinding, but now it can be done in one go.
The effects of the two entries are superimposed. To practice, just step on the left foot and the right foot, and take off on the spot.
That’s why it took only one day to perfect the Wanhua Wuji Kung Fu.
Lu Yuan opened his eyes, and two spiritual lights shot out from the depths of his pupils, illuminating the surrounding walls.
A powerful breath surged out of his body, like a volcano that had been sleeping for thousands of years suddenly erupting.
The breath is like a sharp wind, sweeping away in all directions.
Tables, chairs and benches in the house exploded, and broken wood flew into the air.
The walls were covered with cracks, as if they had been crushed by an invisible force.
Lu Yuan restrained his breath, and the bright spiritual crystals in his meridians shone like a sea of ​​stars.
Entering the first realm!
With one Mortal Transformation Pill, a tall building rises from the ground.
From today on, he is also a first-level warrior.
He stood up and stretched his muscles, and there was a crunching sound like fried beans all over his body.
As the spiritual crystals flickered, the powerful spiritual power within his body surged, and the aura around him poured out like an overwhelming force, which was dozens of times more powerful than some veteran first-level players.
"Cultivating the Wuji Gong of Ten Thousand Transformations to the Perfect Level"Perfection is indeed extraordinary. "
Lu Yuan was in a good mood and fetched water to wash up.
Now that we have entered the first realm, it is time to take on the mission.
...
Qingzhou Town Demon Division, Medical Room.
The smell of medicinal herbs in the air was mixed with the faint smell of blood.
Lin Chen was injured by Lu Yuan yesterday and is still unconscious.
Fortunately, when he was admitted to the Demon Suppression Division, Lin Man'er came with him as a family member, otherwise there wouldn't even be anyone around to take care of him.
At this moment, Lin Man'er's eyes were red and swollen, and she looked at the figure standing beside the bed with a sad face.
"Master Zhou, my brother has excellent qualifications. He has practiced martial arts for five years and finally entered the Demon Suppression Division. However, he was seriously injured by Lu Yuan and fell into coma. Please make the decision for our brother and sister! "
Lin Maner knelt down with a plop, crying so hard that her whole body trembled.
She has no friends in the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division, and Zhou Tong is the only person who knows her and can help her.
“Get up and talk. "
Zhou Tong reached out to help the woman up, then frowned.
After the selection in Yun'an County, he had been out on missions. Unexpectedly, he learned that Lin Chen was seriously injured as soon as he returned to the Demon Suppression Division.
Lin Chen was a newcomer he was optimistic about. He was already at the sixth level of the mortal realm before the entrance examination, but he fell into the hands of Lu Yuan twice in a row.
How is this possible?
After a moment of silence, Zhou Tong asked: "What is going on? You tell the truth. "
Lin Man'er's explanation was unclear. She was not present on the day of the assessment and did not know the truth at all.
It was only when Lin Chen woke up for a while while the doctor was treating her that she learned that the person who hurt her was Lu Yuan.
Zhou Tong frowned and continued to ask: "How high was Lin Chen in yesterday's entrance examination? "
"Second class! Lin Man'er's eyes suddenly showed joy, "A clerk came yesterday and asked Lin Chen to go to the Siwu Hall to register his name after he recovered from his injury. "
"Master Zhou, Lu Yuan must be jealous of my brother, so he took advantage of Lin Chen's lack of condition after the assessment to severely injure him. He wanted to destroy my brother! "
Zhou Tong nodded, he also guessed the same.
Otherwise, how could a mere second-level mortal realm seriously injure Lin Chen.
Lu Yuan is really evil-minded.
When he thought of this, Zhou Tong's eyes suddenly flashed with a cold light.
He originally looked down upon Lu Yuan, but he didn't expect that Lu Yuan would take advantage of someone's danger and seriously injure the demon-suppressing guard who had passed the test.
Doesn't Si Lu Tang just care about it?
Okay, you Si Lutang doesn’t care, I, Zhou Tong, will take care of it!
He took out two taels of silver and placed them beside the bed, and said in a deep voice:
"Don't worry, I am a first-level warrior and a demon-suppressing guard who has been registered for seven years. I have the right to reward and punish newcomers. "
"Lu Yuan must be severely punished for this matter! "
"Thank you, Mr. Zhou, for making the decision for my brother! "Lin Man'er burst into tears of gratitude.
Zhou Tong nodded, as if he had made some determination, and strode out of the hospital room.
